snippet.title: Lineage II Chronicle 2: Age of Splendor - CGI Movie (E3 2003)
snippet.description: This CGI movie tells the tale of ancient and dark powers coming to life once again. A Dark Elf woman explores ancient ruins and Baium comes to life.
